name: Pertamina / Pertamina Enduro
note: Title sponsor of Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team (2024-2026 per Crash.net, 2023-10-14) and title sponsor of the Pertamina Grand Prix of Indonesia (motogp.com/en/sponsors). PT Pertamina Lubricants is 99.96% held by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, part of the Pertamina (Persero) downstream subholding, itself wholly state-owned.
